🏡 Tour Your Dream Home in Skipcha Mountain Estates, Harker Heights, TX! 
Welcome to this gorgeous two-story home located in the highly sought-after Skipcha Mountain! In this video, I’ll take you on a detailed walk-through tour of this stunning property, highlighting all the amazing features that make it the perfect place to call home.

With over 3,100 sq. ft. of living space, 4 spacious bedrooms, and 2.5 baths, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort and functionality. Whether you love to entertain or need extra space for your growing family, this home has it all!

✨ Key Features:
2 Living Areas: Enjoy flexibility with three versatile living spaces—Ideal for a playroom, game room, etc. 
2 Dining Areas: A formal dining room and a cozy breakfast nook make hosting dinners and gatherings a breeze.
Chef’s Kitchen: The kitchen features elegant granite countertops, a large center island, and a walk-in pantry, all seamlessly connected to the family room.
Upstairs Master Suite: A spacious master retreat with a walk-in closet, garden tub, separate shower, and double vanities—your perfect place to unwind.
Outdoor Living: The covered patio overlooks a fenced backyard, perfect for outdoor dining, play, or gardening. A zoned sprinkler system ensures low-maintenance landscaping.
Modern Touches: Enjoy recessed lighting, modern finishes, and a built-in water softener throughout the home.
Located on a 0.19-acre lot, this home offers easy access to local schools—Mountain View Elementary, Union Grove Middle, and Harker Heights High School—plus nearby amenities and Stillhouse Lake Road for added convenience.
Don't miss your chance to see this incredible home! Whether you're looking for your forever home or a spacious property to grow into, this one checks all the boxes.
